v1.feedback: The differential-growth bowl is a genuine form — recognizable vessel silhouette with organic ring texture — and the periodic bloom/recovery cycle is exactly what 'gentle-explosion' asks for, not a rename of the parent. Two risks to address in refinement: cap the outward displacement magnitude so the bloom never scatters particles past ~2× rim radius (right now strength up to 6.5 with rimFactor can fling rim particles very far, momentarily losing all silhouette), and during the recovery fall consider lerping color back through a brief desaturated-rose midtone rather than snapping straight from amber to red, which would sell the 'sigh not scream' intention more convincingly.

v2.feedback: The bloom cycle is well-timed (80/20 stillness-to-action ratio shows restraint), and the red→amber→rose color arc genuinely reads as a swerve on the Kapoor void palette. Two refinements: first, the radial displacement during bloom may not read as 'explosion' at default camera distance — consider adding a brief rotational scatter or slight vertical loft to a subset of rim particles so the bloom has directional drama, not just uniform swelling. Second, the differential growth texture on each ring risks flattening into a smooth torus at distance — bump REPEL_R or add per-vertex size variation keyed to growth age so the organic grain is legible without orbiting in.
